rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that has only just begun.

example.english: This incipient rain has just started, so let’s wait before leaving.
example.traditional: 呢場雨啱啱開始，我哋等陣先走啦。
example.jyutping: ne1 coeng4 jyu5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hoi1 ci2 ngo5 dei6 dang2 zan6 sin1 zau2 laa1

rows.note: Use this when the thing is specifically coming into existence or taking shape, rather than merely starting an activity.

example.english: The incipient form of this new community is starting to take shape.
example.traditional: 呢個新社區嘅雛形開始形成喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 san1 se5 keoi1 ge3 co1 jing4 hoi1 ci2 jing4 sing4 laa3
